_comment: Fixes of the tables and ROMs that do not work as they are, applied by the application (see src/steamframe/TableFixes.h).

Each recipe has its section in docs/Table and ROM Fixes.md ('doc'), which tells why it exists and how it was checked. Raise 'version' when a recipe changes: the tables patched with an older version offer to be patched again.
match: 'files' (parts of the table file name, ignoring case) and/or 'roms' (PinMAME ROM names); when both are given, both must match.

script: text replacements in the table script, written as the table's .vbs. 'find' must be found exactly 'count' times (default 1), or the recipe does not apply. Line ends are '\n', and match the '\r\n' of the script.

rom: switch presses run by the PinMAME plugin once the emulation started, per ROM ('sequences'), then a reset of the machine. Runs by itself when the ROM has no NVRAM yet ('runWithoutNvram'), otherwise when requested.
Users can add their own recipes in fixes.json in the preferences folder, and turn shipped ones off with "disable": ["id", ...].

recipes.title: Back to the Future VR Room: vpmInit called twice
recipes.symptom: The table closes as soon as it starts, back to the lobby, as if it crashed.
recipes.cause: Its init routine bttf_Init calls 'vpmInit Me' twice, the second time after Backdrop_Init. core.vbs refuses a second init of the flippers (cvpmFlips2.Init): it shows a message, which only goes to the log on the Steam Frame, and stops the table (QuitPlayer).
recipes.change: The second 'vpmInit me' of bttf_Init is commented out.

files: vr room back to the future

script.replace:
Backdrop_Init

	' vpmInit me ' Removed by the Steam Frame Edition (fix bttf-vr-room-double-vpminit): already called at the start of bttf_Init

recipes.title: Gottlieb System 3: factory settings of the game
recipes.symptom: Coins are accepted, but the display stays at CREDITS 0 and no game can be started.
recipes.cause: PinMAME creates the NVRAM of a Gottlieb System 3 game filled with zeros. The ROM does not check it and takes the zeros as its settings: every price is 0 coin per credit.
recipes.change: The game loads its factory settings from its own service menu, as an operator would: Self Test, Game Adjustments, Start (load factory settings), Start (English), then the machine is reset. The NVRAM it had is kept as <rom>.nv.bak-<date>.

rom.notice: Patching this table for compatibility: its game loads its factory settings (one time only, about 40 seconds). Please don't press any button until the game restarts.

sequences._menu: Long menu: Self Test twice, left flipper 3 times down to Game Adjustments, right flipper, Start twice
Short menu: Self Test, left flipper to 'load factory settings', Start twice

recipes.title: City Hunter: scores on the cabinet's DMD
recipes.symptom: The DMD of the cabinet stays black. The scores only show on the backglass, under the videos of the PuP pack.
recipes.cause: The pack puts all its screens on the backglass, its DMD screen included, and the table's DMD only shows what the script sends to it. The script can send a scoreboard to UltraDMD, but it ships with UseUltraDMD = 0.
recipes.change: UseUltraDMD is set to 1: the DMD of the cabinet shows the UltraDMD scoreboard (players' scores, ball, credits) and the script's messages (ball saved, extra ball, modes). The scoreboard is refreshed every second instead of every 5 s. The backglass is unchanged.

script.find: Const UseUltraDMD = 0				'0 = Don't use UltraDMD, 1=Use it
script.replace: Const UseUltraDMD = 1				'0 = Don't use UltraDMD, 1=Use it ' Set to 1 by the Steam Frame Edition (fix city-hunter-ultradmd): the pack leaves the cabinet's DMD black
Const UltraDMDUpdateTime	= 1000	' 5000 before the Steam Frame Edition (fix city-hunter-ultradmd): the plugin's UltraDMD does not stutter, and the score followed 5 s late

recipes.title: Aladdin: scores on the cabinet's DMD
recipes.symptom: The DMD of the cabinet stays black. The scores only show on the backglass, with the videos of the PuP pack.
recipes.cause: The pack puts all its screens on the backglass, its DMD screen included, and the table's DMD only shows what the script sends to it. The script can send a scoreboard to UltraDMD, but it ships with UseUltraDMD = 0.
recipes.change: UseUltraDMD is set to 1: the DMD of the cabinet shows the UltraDMD scoreboard (players' scores, ball, credits) and the script's messages (ball saved, extra ball, ball locks). The scoreboard is refreshed every second instead of every 5 s. The backglass is unchanged.

script.find: Const UseUltraDMD = 0				'0 = Don't use UltraDMD, 1=Use it
script.replace: Const UseUltraDMD = 1				'0 = Don't use UltraDMD, 1=Use it ' Set to 1 by the Steam Frame Edition (fix aladdin-ultradmd): the pack leaves the cabinet's DMD black
Const UltraDMDUpdateTime	= 1000	' 5000 before the Steam Frame Edition (fix aladdin-ultradmd): the plugin's UltraDMD does not stutter, and the score followed 5 s late

recipes.title: Star Wars (Sonic 1987): DIP switches of the game
recipes.symptom: Coins seem to be ignored: slot 1 needs 3 coins for a credit, and Start does not start a game, even with credits.
recipes.cause: The DIP switches of the game hold its coin settings and more. The application used to save them as zeros in the NVRAM of the game, and the game does not start a game with them.
recipes.change: The table sets the factory DIP switches of the game before starting it, whatever the NVRAM holds. The DIP options of the table's menu still apply.

script.replace:
Controller.Dip(0) = &H3C : Controller.Dip(1) = &H25 ' Added by the Steam Frame Edition (fix sonic-star-wars-dip-switches): factory DIP switches, an NVRAM may hold zeros
    Controller.Run

recipes.title: Darkest Dungeon: error message when the table starts
recipes.symptom: A runtime error message shows when the table starts, and the option 'Cooperative Mode' is missing from the menu of the table.
recipes.cause: The script declares the option with a default value of 0 and a range of 1 to 2. VPX refuses it with an error, which stops the options routine of the script at that line.
recipes.change: The option now goes from 0 (False, the default) to 1 (True). The next line, which reads that same option by mistake for the LUT selector, is commented out: the selector stays off, as it was with the error.

script.replace: bCoOp = Table1.Option("Cooperative Mode", 0, 1, 1, 0, 0, Array("False (Default)","True")) ' Range 1 to 2 before the Steam Frame Edition (fix darkest-dungeon-coop-option): VPX refuses a default of 0 there, and any value of bCoOp other than 0 turns the mode on

' EnableLUTSelector = Table1.Option("Cooperative Mode", 1, 2, 1, 1, 0, Array("False (Default)","True")) ' Removed by the Steam Frame Edition (fix darkest-dungeon-coop-option): it read the option of the mode above, and never ran
